newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy products close higher as soybeans rally.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy products close higher as soybeans rally.

text.p: CBOT soy product futures closed higher on a rally in soybeans, traders said.

Traders said the Professional Farmers of America estimate of the 1996 U.S. soybean crop at 2.08 billion to 2.1 billion bushels boosted prices. That was below USDA's forecast in August for 2.3 billion bushels of soybeans this year.
Soyoil futures volume was estimated at 22,000 contracts, up from 18,437 Friday, according to the CBOT. Soyoil options volume was estimated at 1,800 contracts, up from 433 Friday.
Soymeal futures volume was estimated at 24,000 contracts, up from 17,381 Friday.
Soymeal options volume was estimated at 3,000 contracts, up from 2,939 Friday.
In the soyoil options pit, Cargill Inc sold 400 October 25.50 cent-per-lb puts. In soymeal options "there was no one big feature but there was decent volume all the way through," a trader said.
Soyoil closed 0.33 to 0.40 cent per lb higher, with September up 0.33 at 25.23 cents. Soymeal closed $1.50 to $3.20 per ton higher, with September up $2.90 at $261.00 a ton.
